subject.title: fix(cron): detect ===DONE_ERR=== sentinel in agent final text as failure signal

question: Should cron-triggered embedded runs treat a final visible line beginning `===DONE_ERR===` as a supported durable failure protocol?
rationale: This is not only an implementation detail: it changes how existing cron replies are classified and can trigger persistent error accounting and user-facing failure alerts.

options.title: Require a structured terminal outcome
options.body: Keep cron state driven only by an explicit harness or runner failure outcome, avoiding interpretation of user-visible assistant text.

options.title: Adopt the sentinel contract
options.body: Accept `===DONE_ERR===` as a cron-only terminal protocol, document its exact terminal-line semantics, and add collision and upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Require a structured terminal outcome
recommendation.body: Keep cron state driven only by an explicit harness or runner failure outcome, avoiding interpretation of user-visible assistant text.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision establishes a repository-wide embedded-agent and cron outcome contract.
